chapters.title: Nǐ Hǎo — Hello, Character by Character
chapters.label: ch:zh-nihao
chapters.canDo: I can greet someone in Mandarin and answer when greeted, reading both characters unaided and saying the greeting with the tone a speaker actually uses rather than the one the dictionary prints.

payoff.summary: A two-line meeting in which both voices say the same word — read from the characters alone, with the first third tone raised by sandhi.

chapters.title: Reading the Greeting — One Piece at a Time
chapters.label: ch:zh-components
chapters.canDo: I can write each component the greeting's two characters are built from, and then assemble both characters from those pieces rather than recalling them as whole shapes.

payoff.summary: The second assembly, built from two components the reader wrote individually a moment earlier — and a caution that the memorable story about why it means what it means is a story, not a source.
